title: Construction Studio: A browser-based modeller for construction and structural systems
description: A parametric model of a building's construction for architecture students. Choose a foundation, ground floor, wall or frame, floor and roof; the building assembles itself on a grid, with members sized from the span rules of thumb used in preliminary design and the arithmetic kept on screen. It can be exploded, cut open, stepped through in build order and compared against an alternative. It contains no structural analysis, deliberately.
